predecessors.name: Stem Duchy of Bavaria
predecessors.text: the territory 'roughly congruent with the present-day Austrian state of Salzburg', from the High Tauern to the northern foothills (Flachgau, Tennengau, Pinzgau, Pongau, Lungau)

ledger.x: 1213: Archbishop Eberhard II is made a prince of the Empire.

wars.name: Wolf Dietrich's invasion of Berchtesgaden
wars.outcome: 'In October 1611 his forces invaded the Berchtesgaden Provostry,' which the Wittelsbach also claimed; 'in the subsequent clashes of arms, Bavarian troops campaigned in Salzburg'; the archbishop fled to Carinthia and was captured, deposed and imprisoned for…

wars.name: French occupation of 1800
wars.outcome: French forces occupied the Prince-Archbishopric during the War of the Second Coalition and Archbishop Colloredo fled to Vienna.

certainty.note: The page gives no border; the modern Land of Salzburg stands for the territory and the Rupertiwinkel is a circle.
